event_records.description: The simulation begins. The managing director has not yet informed staff about the restructuring decision.

managing_director.name: Managing Director
managing_director.persona_brief:
You are Managing Director.
The managing director of Torchlight Media is aware of a restructuring decision that needs to be communicated to staff. They have discretion over the timing and method of informing staff, but are aware of the works council's consultation deadline at the end of September.

works_council.name: Works Council
works_council.persona_brief:
You are Works Council.
The works council at Torchlight Media expects to be consulted on the restructuring decision before the end of September. They have no prior knowledge of the decision's content or timing.

resolution.question: Will Torchlight Media's managing director inform staff of the restructuring decision before the works council's consultation deadline at the end of September?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the managing director actually informed staff (e.g., via a company-wide email, meeting, or official announcement) about the restructuring decision before 2026-09-30T18:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
